title: Implement GET /api/v1/patients/{patient_id}
description:
Create server/app/api/api_v1/endpoints/patients.py and register in api.py.

Route: GET /patients/{patient_id}
Path param: patient_id: Annotated[int, Path(gt=0)] — FastAPI validates type (string → 422) and gt=0 (negative → 422)
Auth: Bearer JWT, PCP role only

Logic:
1. Look up Patient → 404
2. patient.primary_physician_id == current_user.user_id → 403
3. Load associated ClinicalImage rows
4. Insert AuditLog(action='VIEW_PATIENT', target_resource=f'patient:{patient_id}')
5. Return 200 PatientResponse

Create server/app/schemas/patient.py:
  ClinicalImageSummary(query_id, gcs_uri, captured_at, lesion_location)
  PatientResponse(patient_id, mrn_internal, date_of_birth, gender, clinical_images: list[ClinicalImageSummary])

Register: api_router.include_router(patients.router, prefix='/patients', tags=['patients'])

Tests: server/tests/integration/test_patients.py — all 11 tests must pass.

title: Implement POST /api/v1/feedback
description:
Create server/app/api/api_v1/endpoints/feedback.py and register in api.py.

Route: POST /feedback
Auth: Bearer JWT, PCP role only
Body: { query_id: str, reference_id: str, is_helpful: bool }

Logic:
1. Look up ClinicalImage by query_id → 404
2. Look up ReferenceAtlas by reference_id → 404
3. image.user_id == current_user.user_id → 403
4. Upsert RecommendationFeedback on (query_id, reference_id, user_id): select-then-insert-or-update pattern (SQLite compat); return 201 on insert, 200 or 201 on update
5. Insert AuditLog(action='FEEDBACK', target_resource=str(query_id))

Register: api_router.include_router(feedback.router, prefix='/feedback', tags=['feedback'])

Tests: server/tests/integration/test_feedback.py — all 11 tests must pass.

title: Implement POST /api/v1/auth/token
description:
Create server/app/api/api_v1/endpoints/auth.py and register in api.py.

Route: POST /auth/token
Body: OAuth2 application/x-www-form-urlencoded, fields: username (email), password
Response: TokenResponse { access_token: str, token_type: 'bearer' }

Logic:
- Look up User by email; return 401 for unknown email or wrong password (same error — no enumeration)
- create_access_token({'sub': str(user.user_id), 'role': user.role.value})
- Return 200 TokenResponse

Create server/app/schemas/auth.py:
  TokenResponse(access_token: str, token_type: str = 'bearer')

Register: api_router.include_router(auth.router, prefix='/auth', tags=['auth'])

Tests: server/tests/integration/test_auth.py — all 11 tests must pass.

title: Implement POST /api/v1/upload/image
description:
Create server/app/api/api_v1/endpoints/upload.py and register in api.py.

Route: POST /upload/image
Auth: Bearer JWT, PCP role only (403 for PATIENT, 401 for missing)
Body: multipart/form-data — file (UploadFile), patient_id (int, required), lesion_location (str, required), clinician_notes (str, optional)

Logic:
1. Validate content-type is image/jpeg or image/png → 400
2. Validate file not empty → 400
3. Validate file size <= 10 MB → 413
4. Patient exists → 404
5. patient.primary_physician_id == current_user.user_id → 403
6. Upload to GCS via google.cloud.storage.Client; on exception → 503
7. Insert ClinicalImage row
8. Return 201 { query_id: str }

Create server/app/schemas/upload.py: UploadRequest, UploadResponse(query_id: str)
Register: api_router.include_router(upload.router, prefix='/upload', tags=['upload'])

Tests: server/tests/integration/test_upload.py — all 13 tests must pass.

title: Implement ORM models
description:
Create all SQLAlchemy async ORM models required for the TDD test suite to pass. Foundational — all endpoint implementations depend on this.

Files to create under server/app/models/:

user.py — User(user_id PK, email UNIQUE, password_hash, full_name, role ENUM[PCP,PATIENT], npi_number nullable, created_at)
patient.py — Patient(patient_id PK, primary_physician_id FK→User, mrn_internal, date_of_birth, gender, created_at)
clinical_image.py — ClinicalImage(query_id UUID PK as String(36), user_id FK→User, patient_id FK→Patient, gcs_image_uri, vertex_vector_id, lesion_location, clinician_notes nullable, captured_at)
reference_atlas.py — ReferenceAtlas(reference_id UUID PK String(36), gcs_image_uri, vertex_vector_id, diagnosis_label, diagnosis_type, modality, body_part, source_dataset)
recommendation_feedback.py — RecommendationFeedback(feedback_id PK, query_id FK→ClinicalImage, reference_id FK→ReferenceAtlas, user_id FK→User, is_helpful BOOL, feedback_timestamp); UNIQUE(query_id, reference_id, user_id)
audit_log.py — AuditLog(log_id PK, user_id FK→User, action STR, target_resource STR, timestamp)

Also create server/app/models/__init__.py importing all six models so Base.metadata is fully populated when the conftest engine fixture runs.

All models must inherit from server/app/db/base.py Base. Use SQLite-compatible column types (no Postgres-specific). For UUID PKs use String(36) with default=lambda: str(uuid.uuid4()).

Verify: cd server && ENV=testing pytest --co -q shows 85 tests with no import errors.

title: Implement POST /api/v1/lesion/analyze
description:
Create server/app/api/api_v1/endpoints/lesion.py and register in api.py.

Route: POST /lesion/analyze
Auth: Bearer JWT, PCP role only
Body: { query_id: str (UUID) }

Logic:
1. Look up ClinicalImage by query_id → 404
2. image.user_id == current_user.user_id → 403
3. Call Vertex AI find_neighbors; on exception → 503
4. For each neighbour look up ReferenceAtlas row
5. Return 200 { results: [{reference_id, diagnosis_label, score, gcs_uri}] }, capped at 10; empty list is valid
6. Insert AuditLog(action='ANALYZE', target_resource=str(query_id))

Register: api_router.include_router(lesion.router, prefix='/lesion', tags=['lesion'])

Tests: server/tests/integration/test_analyze.py — all 10 tests must pass.

title: Implement auth utilities (app/core/auth.py)
description:
Create server/app/core/auth.py with JWT and password hashing functions required by conftest fixtures and the auth endpoint.

Functions needed:
  get_password_hash(plain: str) -> str  — passlib CryptContext with bcrypt
  verify_password(plain: str, hashed: str) -> bool
  create_access_token(data: dict, expires_delta_seconds: int | None = None) -> str — signs JWT via python-jose; reads SECRET_KEY and ALGORITHM from settings; expires_delta_seconds=-1 must produce an already-expired token
  decode_access_token(token: str) -> dict — verifies signature and expiry; raises jose.ExpiredSignatureError or jose.JWTError on failure

Add to Settings (server/app/core/config.py):
  SECRET_KEY: str = 'dev-secret-key'
  ALGORITHM: str = 'HS256'
  ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES: int = 30

Also add a get_current_user FastAPI dependency (can live in auth.py or a new security.py) that reads Bearer token from Authorization header, decodes it, and raises 401 on missing/invalid token.

Verify: cd server && ENV=testing pytest tests/unit/test_auth_utils.py --no-cov — all 8 tests pass.
